newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 9.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Monday were higher on firmer cargo and swaps levels, traders said. They said bid/asked indications were far apart early Monday but eventually narrowed to $121-$122 and to around $118 per tonne for 380-cst. MDO was unchanged at $200-$205 and gas oil at $215-$216. Enquiries were average as most traders were at APPEC, traders said.
